title: Speed up
prompt: The robot at speed gains acceleration pixels per second every second. Return its speed after one frame. From 0 with acceleration 100, a 0.1 s frame gives 10.
starter:
func solve(speed, acceleration, delta) -> float:
	return speed
hints: Same shape as moving a position, but for speed.
solution:
func solve(speed, acceleration, delta) -> float:
	return speed + acceleration * delta
